events.title: Cursor extends coding agents into deployment monitoring and security review
events.title_zh: Cursor 把 coding agent 延伸到部署监控与安全审查
events.summary: Cursor released Rollouts and Security Review for Teams and Enterprise plans. Rollouts derives a monitoring plan from a pull-request diff, compares production telemetry with a pre-deploy baseline, and can notify, pause a progressive rollout or prepare a revert pull request under policy. Security Review inspects every pull request in whole-codebase context for injection, authorization errors, secrets, unsafe deserialization, redirects, vulnerable dependencies and insecure configuration. Findings include severity, attack path and a proposed fix.
events.why_it_matters: For teams using coding agents, the operational boundary now extends beyond merge. The same system can watch production signals and prepare remediation, which shortens feedback loops but also gives it influence over deployment. Trial with notify-only policies first, require human approval for pause or revert, and measure false positives before widening authority.

events.title: Cursor cuts agent token costs with smaller prompts and lazy tools
events.title_zh: Cursor 用精简 prompt 与按需工具降低 agent token 成本
events.summary: Cursor reports a 7% reduction in user token cost without measured quality loss after cutting about two-thirds of its system prompt, loading low-frequency tool definitions lazily, improving cache boundaries and numbering only every tenth source line. The cache changes reduced cold misses by 20%. Earlier lazy loading of MCP tool definitions cut total tokens by 46.9% in sessions that invoked MCP, while offloading built-in tool definitions reduced static description tokens by 60%. The results come from Cursor's production traffic and A/B tests, not an independent benchmark.
events.why_it_matters: For teams operating long-running agents, this is a practical optimization order: shrink the stable prefix, load tool schemas only when needed, make cache boundaries explicit, compress file context, then add subagents selectively. The hard part is preserving behavior while changing context shape, so each optimization needs task-level regression tests rather than token metrics alone.
events.summary_zh: Cursor 报告了一组生产环境里的 context 优化：系统 prompt 缩短约三分之二，低频工具定义按需加载，缓存边界更稳定，源码只给每十行编号一次。组合后用户 token 成本下降 7%，没有测到质量下降；冷缓存 miss 减少 20%。此前对 MCP 工具定义做按需加载，使实际调用 MCP 的会话总 token 减少 46.9%；内置工具定义移出静态上下文后，描述 token 减少 60%。这些结果来自 Cursor 自己的流量与 A/B 测试，不是独立 benchmark。
events.summary_en: Cursor reports a 7% reduction in user token cost without measured quality loss after cutting about two-thirds of its system prompt, loading low-frequency tool definitions lazily, improving cache boundaries and numbering only every tenth source line. The cache changes reduced cold misses by 20%. Earlier lazy loading of MCP tool definitions cut total tokens by 46.9% in sessions that invoked MCP, while offloading built-in tool definitions reduced static description tokens by 60%. The results come from Cursor's production traffic and A/B tests, not an independent benchmark.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行长时程 agent 的团队来说，这给出了一个实用优化顺序：先缩短稳定前缀，再按需加载工具 schema，明确缓存边界，压缩文件上下文，最后有选择地引入 subagent。难点是 context 形态改变后仍要保持行为一致，所以每项优化都需要任务级回归测试，不能只看 token 指标。

The hard part is preserving behavior while changing context shape, so each optimization needs task-level regression tests rather than token metrics alone.

events.title: Claude agents surface a new reverse-transcriptase system for lab testing
events.title_zh: Claude agent 找到新的逆转录酶系统并进入实验验证
events.summary: Anthropic says about 950 Claude agents used 210 million tokens over 21 hours to survey more than 200,000 reverse transcriptases, identify 3,500 candidate systems and narrow them to 20 reports. Human scientists tested the strongest candidate in a BSL-1/2 lab. The resulting array-associated reverse transcriptase system combines an RT, a partner gene and a repeated DNA array; early experiments show the array is expressed as short RNAs. Its biological function remains unknown and further experiments are ongoing.
events.why_it_matters: For research-agent builders, this is a rare end-to-end example where a large agent fleet generated a hypothesis that survived human review and reached wet-lab testing. It does not show autonomous scientific validation: humans designed and performed the experiments, the study is vendor-run, and the function is unresolved. Treat it as a workflow pattern to watch, not proof of a CRISPR-scale discovery.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 称，大约 950 个 Claude agent 用 21 小时和 2.1 亿 token 筛查了 20 多万个逆转录酶，找出 3,500 个候选系统，再收敛为 20 份报告。人类科学家随后在 BSL-1/2 实验室测试最强候选。得到的 array-associated reverse transcriptase 系统包含一个逆转录酶、一个伴随基因和重复 DNA 阵列；初步实验显示该阵列会表达为短 RNA。它的生物学功能仍不清楚，后续实验还在进行。

events.title: PASTABench finds agent safety monitors intervene too late
events.title_zh: PASTABench 发现 agent 安全监控常常介入太晚
events.summary: PASTABench evaluates proactive safety monitoring on 1,139 multi-turn agent trajectories across five risk categories and 13 subcategories. It labels the earliest warning and the actual trigger so monitors are scored on whether, when and why they intervene. Across 16 LLMs, the best system intervened inside the optimal window only 40.74% of the time. Smaller models often lost apparent safety performance when hazard vocabulary was neutralized, exposing keyword matching rather than risk understanding.
events.why_it_matters: For teams deploying multi-step agents, a post-hoc incident label is not a control. Safety monitors need to catch the trajectory after enough evidence appears but before the harmful transition. Add timing and paraphrase robustness to monitor acceptance tests; do not accept a high aggregate classifier score without checking the intervention window.
events.summary_zh: PASTABench 用 1,139 条多轮 agent 轨迹评估主动安全监控，覆盖五类风险和 13 个子类。数据同时标注最早预警点和真正触发点，因此可以分别判断是否介入、何时介入、识别了什么风险。16 个 LLM 中，最佳系统也只有 40.74% 的介入落在最佳窗口。部分小模型在危险词汇被中性化后表现明显坍塌，说明它们主要在匹配关键词，而不是理解风险演化。

It labels the earliest warning and the actual trigger so monitors are scored on whether, when and why they intervene. Across 16 LLMs, the best system intervened inside the optimal window only 40.74% of the time. Smaller models often lost apparent safety performance when hazard vocabulary was neutralized, exposing keyword matching rather than risk understanding.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对部署多步 agent 的团队来说，事后给事故贴标签不等于控制。安全监控必须在证据已经充分、但危险状态尚未发生的窗口内介入。验收时应加入介入时机和改写鲁棒性；只有一个很高的分类总分还不够。

events.title: SWE-Flux tests whether coding models understand runtime behavior
events.title_zh: SWE-Flux 测试 coding 模型是否真正理解运行时行为
events.summary: SWE-Flux contains 480 repository-level questions grounded in instrumented test executions from 12 real Python repositories. Gold answers are harvested from runtime traces instead of written by an LLM judge. The questions cover control flow, loops, state, dataflow, exceptions and invariants across single and multiple tests. Five evaluated LLMs remained weak: the best reached 37% accuracy, and models struggled most with inter-procedural dataflow, precise state and suite-level aggregation.
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, passing tests does not show that a model understands why the program behaved that way. Execution-grounded questions can expose brittle patches and weak debugging reasoning before those failures appear in production. Trial a small internal version using instrumented tests from your own repositories, and refresh variants so the model cannot memorize static answers.
events.summary_zh: SWE-Flux 包含 480 道仓库级动态执行题，来自 12 个真实 Python 仓库的插桩测试。标准答案从运行轨迹自动采集，不依赖 LLM judge 编写。题目覆盖控制流、循环、程序状态、数据流、异常与不变量，并同时考查单测试和多测试场景。五个受测 LLM 的最佳准确率只有 37%，最难的是跨过程数据流、精确状态推理和整套测试聚合。

Five evaluated LLMs remained weak: the best reached 37% accuracy, and models struggled most with inter-procedural dataflow, precise state and suite-level aggregation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，测试通过不代表模型理解程序为什么这样运行。基于真实执行的题目能在上线前暴露脆弱补丁和薄弱的调试推理。可以先从自家仓库的插桩测试做小规模试验，并持续生成新变体，避免模型记住固定答案。
